itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The printed Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p7) carry only 'See attached' and NO subtotal or total figures, and the spreadsheet attachments print no per-page subtotals - only a grand Total at the end of each. So the gates here are whole-side, and BOTH CLOSED TO THE CENT: 97 contribution rows across pages 4-6 sum to 25705.00 against the printed Total, and 24 expenditure rows on page 8 sum to 10242.35 against its printed Total. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: every page has as many names as amounts, and the Occupation/Employer cells that ARE populated match their donors (Peter Metcalf/CEO/Black Diamond, John Cumming/Ski resort owner/Powdr Corp., David Finn/Attorney/Milner & Finn).
itemized.escalation_note: pages 4-6 and 8 re-rendered at 300 dpi and rotated with PIL - pages 4-6 needed a CLOCKWISE rotation and page 8 a COUNTER-CLOCKWISE one (the sign differs between attachments inside the SAME filing); geometry percentages were converted back to the portrait page as poppler renders it, using the correct inverse for each
itemized.notes: SPREADSHEET ATTACHMENTS, and the two attachments are rotated in OPPOSITE directions inside the same PDF. The printed Schedule A (PDF p3) and Schedule B (PDF p7) each carry only the handwritten words 'See attached' in the first data row, with no subtotal or total. The itemization is on four landscape spreadsheet pages titled 'Holly Mullen for County Council Schedule A' (PDF p4-p6, 97 rows) and 'Holly Mullen for County Council Schedule B' (PDF p8, 24 rows), both dated 5-Apr-10. THE ADDRESS / CITY / STATE / ZIP COLUMNS ARE COUNTY-REDACTED by one large white rectangle spanning the contribution pages - the ONLY exception is the first row of page 5 (David Finn), which the rectangle does not cover and whose city/state are therefore recorded; ghost text bleeds below the rectangle's bottom edge on the last row of page 4, confirming it is a redaction rather than an empty column. The first row of page 4 is an AGGREGATE ('Contributions of $50 or under', $195.00) with an empty date cell. The last three rows of page 6 have the FIRST NAME and LAST NAME columns SWAPPED by the filer (Stewart Elizabeth / Brown Sue and Norm / Melini Louis) - recorded in the printed order and flagged, not silently reversed. Expenditure row 2 carries an impossible date, '2/5/1020'. Filer spellings kept verbatim: 'Joeseph Lyon', 'Foundaiton', 'Filing Fee's', 'Photo's', 'Hipe Media Group', 'Taffy town', 'xpedex'. One expenditure is a filing-fee payment to Sherrie Swensen, the Salt Lake County Clerk - who is herself a filer elsewhere in this chunk.
